major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your main cooldown every 60 seconds: dump Fingers of Frost and your Freezing stacks first (Ice Lance at 6+ on Spellslinger, 10+ on Frostfire) so the channel refills them, and on Spellslinger send it below 3 Icicles or within 25 seconds of your potion.

major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every 60 seconds and decide the cleave angle before it comes off cooldown; it sits above Glacial Spike in every priority and turns Blizzard instant through Freezing Rain.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On Spellslinger pair it with the GCD after Frozen Orb or with Ray of Frost, on Frostfire use it on cooldown, and always burn the last one inside the final 35 seconds of the fight.

defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity for 10 seconds: eat a lethal hit or clear a debuff with it, accepting the lost casts and the 30 second Hypothermia lockout.

defensives.name: Ice Cold
defensives.usage_rule: 70% damage reduction for 6 seconds while you keep casting: use it on scripted raid damage you have to cast through.

defensives.name: Ice Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep the absorb up at all times against rolling raid damage and refresh it just before a known spike.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a heavy hit and reactivate inside 10 seconds to snap back to your old health and position.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: 20 seconds of untargetable invisibility: use it to sidestep a targeted mechanic or drop threat, and remember any action cancels it.

rules.description: Flurry on every Brain Freeze proc
rules.action: Spend Brain Freeze with Flurry as it comes, ahead of Frozen Orb and Glacial Spike; on Thermal Void builds send it while Thermal Void is down so the next Ice Lance shatters the extra 4 stacks.

rules.description: Ice Lance over Frostbolt on Fingers of Frost
rules.action: While Fingers of Frost is up, Ice Lance is your filler instead of Frostbolt: it hits as if it consumed the target's maximum Freezing even at zero stacks, so never let a charge sit and dump at once when you reach 2.

rules.description: Frostbolt, Ray of Frost, Ice Lance opener
rules.action: Precast Frostbolt, open with Ray of Frost, then Ice Lance before falling into the priority; on Frostfire precast Frostfire Bolt at 2 seconds on the countdown and follow it with Ray of Frost.

Keep the single-target priority through 2 targets and only bring Blizzard in at 3 or more on Frostfire (4 or more with Freezing Rain, 6 or more without) and 5 or more on Spellslinger; cast it inside Freezing Rain so it is instant, since hardcast Blizzard loses to generating Splinters.

rules.description: Potion of Recklessness paired with Frozen Orb
rules.action: On Spellslinger drink on the GCD right after Frozen Orb, stacking the 30 second stat buff with your trinkets and racial, and hold Ray of Frost so it lands inside the same 25 second window.

source_summary: Frost Mage runs two 60 second cooldowns, Ray of Frost as the main channel and Frozen Orb as the AoE follow-up, and both are pressed close to on cooldown rather than pooled for a burst window. Ray of Frost goes out after your Freezing stacks and Fingers of Frost charges have been spent, since the channel refills them, and Frozen Orb is planned around incoming cleave and the instant Blizzard it enables. Potion, trinkets and racials pair with Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost on Spellslinger and go on cooldown on Frostfire, with the rest of the rotation reacting to Brain Freeze and Fingers of Frost procs.
